# Derived planning adjudication

Mode: Workflow, selected by the existing public verification specification. Five requested Analyze reports returned, followed by exactly one Cross-examine report from each role. Roles used separate contexts and shared all five reports only at the report barrier. Initial role questions did not supply peer reports or author conclusions. No third round was required. This is method execution coverage, not implementation or website approval.

Target input: `1461fc149209fa29adc067a2b8f3c644055228aa0a2f45485779e3a418f47fd6`; generated candidate manifest: `0540496cea29da71f72046f36a12c3a23b4d71900c97f7193f4dba699836b036`; profile: `qaizen-labs` 0.1.0, digest `f76afdd45cb6352e5044a06affc4182ea6cd40aa9c012fb216636a61faa428f0`.

| Material decision | Alternatives and evidence | Adjudication and remaining execution |
|---|---|---|
| Reuse and scoped completion | All roles identify implemented traversal; generic empty-action COMPLETE is legitimate but insufficient for Labs acceptance. | Preserve the generic interpreter and schema. Require a Labs check-to-evidence map plus enclosing runtime-input identity. Reject a new mandatory registry or fourth skill. |
| Returned state | Product/Architecture/UX/QA show that generic heading focus alone does not prove the introduction. The current public capture supplies Start and summary predicates already named in the contract. | Assert Start visible and summary absent after Back while retaining heading focus. Initial introduction uses the same Start predicate. A retained-question fixture must fail. No website source change or invented product label. |
| Unanswered scope | Endpoint-only checking after Back can be vacuous when controls unmount; no role proves an actual live selection. | Add a single check after Close/before Back and keep entry/final checks. Review the action list for no answer activation. Do not claim continuous absence of arbitrary transient selection. |
| Help coverage | Reopened help lacks an explicit open assertion; Close focus must not be substituted by Back. | Assert reopen and capture or retain equivalent attribute evidence. Execute a wrong-Close-focus control independently. |
| Async focus | The old 900 ms post-action pause already covers ordinary frame delay; only a longer controlled delay discriminates the proposed change. | Choose bounded 15-second focus/attribute observation, no repeated activation or forced focus. Test delay beyond 900 ms and never-correct state. This timeout is not a product SLA. Keep existing finite URL wait and add delayed/missing URL controls. |
| Policy | Existing main-frame test cannot establish popup behavior. Service-worker blocking configuration is required; an attempt campaign was explicitly optional in QA's challenge. | Execute popup and redirect-origin negatives; retain blocked analytics as expected policy evidence. Keep service workers blocked before navigation. Do not silently narrow origins or send POST. No claim of generalized side-effect safety. |
| Privacy and optional diagnostics | Trace/DOM/video differ from projected structured events. No broad retention guarantee was measured. Product and Delivery oppose mandatory trace/video merely as proxy metrics. | Narrow the event-projection statement and keep raw artifacts private. Required assertions/events and inspected state captures establish scoped checks. Optional diagnostics missing means an explicit limit; missing required proof means incomplete coverage. Cleanup-fault injection/canary certification remain optional, not hidden release gates. |
| Test dependencies and cost | The planning input intentionally omitted the fixture/context dependency; this is not evidence they are absent in the real repository. Delivery withdrew numeric hour ranges. | Bind actual fixture, context helper and optional driver from the implementation checkout. Use relative risk/size and the parent investment cap; no duration/cost promise. Preserve local-only rollback and failed evidence. |

The final specification preserves L01–L07 and adds L08–L09 for state discrimination and bounded focus readiness. Its three diagrams and source-backed task order remain. Required implementation/controls/current-site evidence remain distinct. No current website defect, superiority result, external human trial or publication is asserted.
